text:
Zara: Quick heads-up post-launch triage — we have a few small regressions surfacing in customer reports. Need 2-3 low-risk items to ship in the next 2 sprints. No heavy infra. Suggestions? :raising_hand:

Owen: My shortlist: (1) transient 429 handling at the API edge, (2) streaming UI shows stale spinner when chunking stalls, (3) narrow revert of a postprocess tweak affecting embed precision for a small set of customers.

Helena: +1. For (3) prefer per-org model pin & 10% canary traffic for 48h. That keeps blast radius tiny.

Marta: Agreed. Also propose a quick backlog hygiene ticket: add a required "rollback plan" checkbox to any post-launch PR. We lacked this during rollout and it slowed us down.

Zara: Draft acceptance criteria (ACs):
- API 429 retry: "<1% 429s observed per org over 24h post-deploy; retries succeed and p99 delta <25%."
- Streaming UX: "shows last-chunk timestamp and a soft 'retry' link after 7s stall; no regressions in visual QA."
- Embed revert: "per-org eval set shows >=3pt uplift in precision@5 or abort canary."

Owen: Dev estimates: 429 patch = 6-8h (edge change + tests), streaming UX = 2-3h (UX + copy), embed revert = ~2 days (ML + ops canary).

PatchBot: [canary] Canary job scheduled for API 429 patch. Window 3h, auto-rollback on p99/pct-error thresholds.

Helena: Ops guardrails: abort canary if p95 latency increases >25% or error-rate >2x baseline. We'll also add a synthetic probe that hits the retry path every 30s.

Marta: I'll own the grooming ticket and record the rollback checkbox + rubric (impact, rollback complexity, data risk). I'll post a Loom tomorrow with the rubric.

Zara: Can we add a tiny test snippet for the retry behavior in the ticket? e.g.:
```
# pseudo-test for retry
resp = call_edge()
assert resp.status in (200, 201)
# ensure retries didn't increase p99 beyond threshold
```

Owen: Nice. QA pairing: I can pair with Marta for the synthetic tests and smoke harness.

Helena: For embed canary, I'll coordinate with ML infra. @Zara please drop the list of affected org IDs into the ticket so we can pick the per-org eval sets.

Zara: Will do. Owners recap: Owen -> API retry lead, Helena -> embed canary orchestration, Marta -> grooming + rollback checklist, Owen+Marta -> QA harness. Ship targets: retry (1 day), streaming UX (0.5 day), embed canary (2 days).

PatchBot: [notice] Staging patch uploaded for API retry. Canary ready once owners mark ready.

Marta: Timeline ok. I'll post Loom + rubric and create the backlog ticket now. If anyone thinks scope is off, flag in 6h. :thumbsup:
